newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine central bank cuts key rate to 35 pct vs 40.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine central bank cuts key rate to 35 pct vs 40.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank reduced its key refinancing rate to 35 percent from 40 percent, effective from January 10, a bank official said on Saturday.
Central bank spokesman Dmytro Rikberg told Reuters the new rate took into account the fall in inflation.
The previous refinancing rate had been in effect since July 2, 1996.

Ukraine's Statistics Ministry reported on Saturday that December monthly inflation fell to 0.9 percent from 1.2 percent in November. Annual inflation fell to 39.7 percent against 181.7 percent in 1995. The government said inflation for the coming year will be 25 percent. --Kiev newsroom, +380 44 229 2264
